summary.name: Mistral
summary.one_liner: Mistral is an AI company offering frontier open-weight models that organizations can customize, deploy, and run on their own infrastructure.
use_cases: Run AI models on-premises or in a private VPC
Customize models with proprietary data and code
Keep intellectual property under organizational control
Speed up KYC and compliance processes in banking
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Mistral as a provider of frontier open-weight models that organizations can own and control. It describes Forge as a way to customize models and Studio as a way to deploy them. Deployment is offered on-premises, in a customer's VPC, or through Mistral's cloud. The page is mostly customer testimonials from energy, semiconductor, aerospace, banking and government organizations, with few technical specifics. It names no pricing, model list or API details.
notable: Open-weight models that the customer owns and controls
Forge for customizing models and Studio for deploying them
Deployment on-prem, in a private VPC, or on Mistral's cloud
Named enterprise and government customers such as TotalEnergies, ASML, Airbus, BNP Paribas, NATO and the European Patent Office
caveats: Page gives no pricing details, so cost is unclear
Page is mainly marketing and customer quotes with few technical specifics
